classic.blurb: The current look. Near-black cards, one purple accent, heat-colour lanes, big condensed headline.

paper.blurb: Editorial newsprint. Cream stock, heavy ink borders, italic serif headline, vermilion accent. Reads like a printed report.

terminal.blurb: Phosphor CRT. Monospace everywhere, square corners, green glow, uppercase headline.

brutal.blurb: Neo-brutalism. Yellow page, white cards, thick black outlines and hard offset shadows, hot-pink accent.

signal.blurb: Black and red instrument panel. Mono labels, one red signal colour, grey ramp until something spikes.

aurora.blurb: Glass over a moving-colour backdrop. Translucent blurred cards, cyan accent, soft light ramp.

mint.blurb: Calm clinical light theme. Mint page, white cards, teal accent, soft shadows.

amber.blurb: Trading-desk amber on black. Dense, square, monospace, everything glows amber.

violet.blurb: Deep purple with large 32px cards and bright lilac accent. Closest to the Hostinger screenshots you liked.

lime.blurb: Graphite with acid-lime accent, tight 8px corners. Sporty and sharp.

sand.blurb: Warm sand and forest green, serif display with sans body. Quiet and premium.

ice.blurb: Cool light blue, white cards, royal-blue accent with soft blue shadows.

dots.blurb: Nothing-style monochrome: black, white hairlines, mono labels, one red signal. Echoes the LED matrix on the board.

panel.blurb: Teenage Engineering instrument panel: aluminium grey, square cells with 1px gaps, orange accent, mono type.

linear.blurb: Calm density: neutral near-black, tiny tight rows, a single restrained violet accent.

crt.blurb: CRT phosphor with scanlines and glow, VT323-style type. Louder cousin of Terminal.

rings.blurb: Pure black with Apple-Fitness neon ramp (cyan, lime, yellow, pink-red) and generous 24px bento cards.

stripe.blurb: Crisp white with indigo accent, layered soft shadows and a pale gradient wash at the top.

slate.blurb: Cool blue-grey cards with a single teal accent. Calm and technical.

ember.blurb: Charcoal brown with a burnt-orange glow, like coals under ash.

oxide.blurb: Deep green-black with rust accent. Serif headline against clean sans body.

plum.blurb: Aubergine surfaces and a hot-pink accent with rounded, friendly type.

cobalt.blurb: Midnight navy and electric cobalt. Crisp blue rules.

graphite.blurb: Pure monochrome. White accent on black, mono type, tiny radii.

moss.blurb: Forest floor green with a lime highlight and soft corners.

dusk.blurb: Twilight purple and a warm gold accent.

neon.blurb: Synthwave: black violet with hot magenta outlines and glow.

ocean.blurb: Deep sea teal with sky-blue accent and large soft cards.

rose.blurb: Blush paper, raspberry accent, Didot-style display type.

citrus.blurb: Sunny yellow page, orange accent, hard offset shadows.

sky.blurb: Airy pale blue with big rounded cards.

lavender.blurb: Soft lilac surfaces and a vivid violet accent.

ledger.blurb: Accounting paper: cream, thin ruled lines, blue pen accent, mono.

chalk.blurb: Green chalkboard with off-white chalk strokes.

coral.blurb: Warm coral and white, friendly and bright.

mono-light.blurb: Black on white, zero radius, no colour except heat lanes.

olive.blurb: Army-surplus olive and khaki, serif headlines.

sunrise.blurb: Peach dawn with a crimson accent.

steel.blurb: Brushed-steel greys with a quiet slate-blue accent.

toxic.blurb: Black with acid-green outlines and heavy type.

glacier.blurb: Cold white-teal with a deep cyan accent.

candy.blurb: Bubblegum pink, cyan accent, fat borders and pill-round cards.

noir.blurb: Film-noir black, bone text, brass accent, hairline rules.

pixel.blurb: 8-bit arcade: heavy borders, zero radius, yellow highlights.

zen.blurb: Quiet off-white, huge radii, one muted amber accent.

aero.blurb: Frosted-glass cards over a bright sky gradient.
